title: Conversely- never would’ve thought of Nikki for Audrey but that is ab...
transcript: When I saw that Jordan Fisher was going to be starring as Seymour in the off Broadway production of Little Shop of horrors, my first thought was, oh, he's coming back. Because I would have bet actual money that he had played Seymour in this production of Little Shop, because it just feels like a role that he would have played somehow. No, he has not played this role before. And while I am kind of shocked that it took us so long to get here, I am also very glad that we got here. This is excellent casting. Jordan Fisher is just consistently so great in every single role. He's probably my favorite Orpheus. He was so great in Urine Town. I wish that had transferred. It was inevitable casting, but it is also perfect casting. Speaking of which, Andy Karl as a dentist is another casting that feels inevitable yet perfect. I also would have sworn he's already done this, but I think I'm just thinking of his character and teeth, which was very dentist esque. And to someone who loved to teeth the musical, this might be the closest we get to getting teeth back off Broadway. So, like, props to the Little Shop casting team, because they've done it again.
classificationReason: Creator is reacting to casting news (Jordan Fisher as Seymour, Andy Karl as the dentist). No indication they attended the production; the video is entirely about casting reactions and speculation.
